The previous non-damaging-carrier-only initialization rule let Main emit a null birth and lose all four passive sequences. Exact designated target meshes must be initialized before their declared dependents irrespective of whether that carrier also deals damage. Brandish Breaker START EFFECT0 is explicitly forced-owner, so that member is not evidence of the same initial target-order defect.

ownershipIntegration.castPhaseLimit: This presentation-lifecycle patch does not infer the caster phase from NPC1641. The separately closed captured registrar/callback/request consumer in contracts/elesis-blood-cutter-delay-v37.json establishes caster DUMMY .01, request delay float32 .3, then NPC-local .01 display and .1 motion. Server acknowledgement timing and original-client runtime trajectories remain unmeasured; this field does not supersede that source contract.
